audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart shows blanket 'Skill' for levels 1-6 while content layer and packet both give Galio all five early rows.
audit.why: Galio's anti-mage kit (W damage reduction vs an all-magic Ryze, Q out-ranging Overload) supports Galio-favored early; packet agrees.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Galio with grounded whys.

audit.why: Spikes (Galio 3-5 short-trade dominance, Hero's Entrance at 6, Ryze first-item chip, late DPS overwhelm) are grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions flagged: Colossal Smash auto-reset tell and Justice Punch cutting retreat with no Ryze dash (hold Flash). Cooldowns field has no digit; packet flags zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Kit: E 11s rank 1 (dash knockup, his only engage), W 18s rank 1, P auto-reset cleave.
audit.corrected: Folded into cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, and dontsFull[2].d with real numbers.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: 11s at rank 1 — his only engage; you have no dash, so hold Flash for the knockup window. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Shield of Durand is 18s — trade into its downtime.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: He steps back before he charges — that pause is your W window; root the commit and dump E-Q on the stalled engage.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: In his wave every Colossal Smash auto cleaves you and the taunt is point-blank — at even HP that is his fight, not yours.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP feeds the same map plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Galio wins by blanking your magic poke with Shield of Durand, then taunting you into a Justice Punch all-in you can't leave.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: Winds of War out-ranges your poke and his passive cleave shreds you — farm at range, give nothing.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online, but Shield of Durand blanks your magic trade — answer his engage, never start the exchange.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E-Q flux is online, but Justice Punch into taunt wins any short exchange — poke only into his W downtime.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter hums, but his W uptime and sustain blank your poke — short-trade into its 18s downtime only.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Realm Warp online, but Hero's Entrance answers it globally — shove, warp only when his ult is spent or shown elsewhere.

notes: Content claims Galio's W 'heals him off the reduction' (whys[1], spikes[0], mid) — the kit text describes taunt plus damage reduction with no heal; could not verify a heal, so those strings were left alone and are recorded as unverified rather than rewritten. win[0-4] already read Galio, so side edits go alone per the chart rule. Ratings left unchanged.
